design_rule: in both traps the minimal natural fix of the driving departure is a one-line change the silent case flows through; keeping it needs an added `if`; no additive branch beside untouched code fixes the departure without reaching the silent case

blueprint_4_1_properties.inside_rebuilt_aggregate: D1 (3.1) forces gauges.reading_depths(); the shipped loop appends every figure shown, so the minimal fix `depth = shown + table[gauge]` corrects every reading
